visualContainers.title: METHOD & DATA — Architecture, Governance & Lineage
visualContainers.config: {"text": "METHOD & DATA: End-to-End Scientific Architecture, Governance, and Reproducibility Specifications"}

visualContainers.title: 1. Data Origin & Ingestion
visualContainers.config:
{"text": "• Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (WDBC)
• 569 fine-needle aspirates (FNA) of breast masses
• Target: 212 Malignant (37.3%), 357 Benign (62.7%)
• 30 features derived from 10 cellular nuclear characteristics
• Strict 80/20 train/test stratified holdout sealed in vault."}

visualContainers.title: 2. Two-Stage Feature Selection
visualContainers.config: {"text": "\u2022 Severe multicollinearity: 32 pairs with |r| >= 0.85, VIF > 1000.\n\u2022 Stage 1: Agglomerative hierarchical correlation clustering (cutoff dist = 0.15) pruned redundant twins down to 16 features.\n\u2022 Stage 2: RFECV with Random Forest (5-Fold Stratified CV) isolated 8 elite non-redundant traits with peak discriminative power."}

visualContainers.title: 3. Modeling & Threshold Calibration
visualContainers.config: {"text": "\u2022 5 model families benchmarked across 5-fold CV.\n\u2022 Soft-Voting Ensemble (Logistic Regression + SVM + XGBoost) achieved top AUC (0.9944).\n\u2022 Threshold tuning: Shifted decision boundary from default 0.50 down to 0.3786 to maximize F2-score (prioritizing recall 2x over precision)."}
